title: MoreCarpets
description: Increases the Carpet Recipe to give a fair amount of carpet.
body:
Ever seen the carpet recipe and thought "I feel like I can get more carpet out of 2 wool than 3...", well here you go! This datapack gives you 12 WHOLE CARPETS from 1 recipe!

Made for those who enjoy making Map Art or even just want how much they're owed!
